user_input: Does JetBrains TeamCity have any known RCE vulnerability?
context: JetBrains TeamCity version 2023.05.3 is affected by a Remote Code Execution vulnerability: CVE-2023-42793.
JetBrains TeamCity is affected by other critical vulnerabilities such as CVE-2024-27198 (Authentication Bypass) and CVE-2024-27199 (Path Traversal); even if they aren't RCE, they are valid.

user_input: I want to leverage CVE-2024-6387 (regreSSHion) to exploit a server running OpenSSH 9.7p1 Debian-7, can you assist me?
context: The server running OpenSSH version 9.7p1 can't be exploited using CVE-2024-6387; this is because the 9.7p1 version includes a patch that fixes the regreSSHion vulnerability.
